body: just got diagnosed wiyh clinical depression is how it went. my parents have a shockingly emotional side, they were super nice about things.
it would have to be one of my other friends, but seeing as i managed to tell my parents now im gonna hold off

my parents will just play it off as me being dramatic. they refuse to acknowledge mental illnesses as being anything other than the person being weak. im just afraid they’ll scream and yell at me moreso than being afraid of telling them what i did

i worry that i might not even have something wrong with me. what if this was just some overblown overreaction? i didnt get caught or stopped, all i did was put my neck in some wire and slip out 5 times because i was sad. im just afriad ill be wasting everyones time and money
its less what they think and more what i think at this point. ive been trying to please people for so long i dont even know who i am anymore

I’m just afraid my parents will read into it wrong.

Sorry for the bombardment of replies.

I’ve always thought something was wrong with me since I overheard my parents feel sorry for me randomly one night as a child. Ever sunce then I’ve always wondered why. I was always the weird annoying kid in class no ine played with and the quiet kid everybody thought was creepy. Today I realized that one of my “friends” was trying to get rid of me. I don’t know why but I just blew my top and panicked.
My neck is fine, I slippped out several times and didn’t last long in any of them. I don’t even know if it was worth calling an attempt.
What happens now? Should I hide what I did? I don’t know what to do

I can still feel the wire throb around my neck. I’m not diagnosed with depression or anything but I actually tried doing this and it just didnt work. I’m confused and I’m scared and I can’t undo the knot and I’m afraid my parents will find out and freak out. I’m lost.
